rent.note: furnished monthly apartment (monthly mansion) near Hakata/Tenjin ~JPY 100,000 at 157.8 JPY/USD; no deposit/key money; Wi-Fi usually included. SUUMO Chuo-ku unfurnished 1LDK average JPY 95,000 for comparison

utilities.source: financial-field.com (Statistics Bureau 2025 Family Income and Expenditure Survey)
utilities.note: single-household fuel, light and water JPY 12,988/mo for Kyushu-Okinawa, + ~JPY 2,000 buffer for summer AC; home internet assumed included in the monthly apartment

groceries.note: single-household food JPY 44,659 minus eating out JPY 9,761 = ~JPY 34,900 (~$221) for home food

diningOut.note: ~JPY 35,000: a nomad eats out far more than the JPY 9,761 resident average; ramen/teishoku ~JPY 1,000, yatai and izakaya evenings extra

transit.note: compact walkable core; ~JPY 9,500 of subway rides. Ceiling: contactless monthly fare cap / Chika Pass JPY 12,570 (~$80); 1 Day Pass JPY 640

coworking.note: The Company (Tenjin/Hakata/Daimyo, six sites) free-desk plan JPY 22,330/mo incl. tax

simData.note: visitor voice+data SIM, 10GB JPY 3,630/mo (30GB JPY 4,378); one-off SIM fee JPY 4,455 not included

misc.note: gym, toiletries, sento/onsen, outings, buffer; set below Osaka's $200

accomSeasonality._doc: Editorial: monthly-apartment rates are fairly flat; small bump in Mar-Apr (sakura + Japan's spring moving season), slight dips in the rainy June and typhoon-season September.
